what: length of baseboard / skirting / floor trim needed in one named room
how: find the room by its name
take its perimeter from the traced outline
subtract the widths of the door openings on its boundary
add waste if a percentage is given

what: length of baseboard / skirting needed for the whole floor or building, no room named
how: take every room
perimeter minus door openings for each
add them up
add waste if a percentage is given

what: floor area of one named room
how: find the room by its name
read the area of its traced outline

what: total floor area of the whole plan, floor or building
how: take every room
add up the outline areas

what: wall surface of one named room for painting, plastering or tiling, with a ceiling height given
how: find the room by its name
perimeter minus door widths
multiply by the ceiling height from the question

what: perimeter / circumference of one named room
how: find the room by its name
read the length of its traced outline

what: how many doors are on the plan
how: count the door symbols found by the detector
flag the count when detections sit near the confidence threshold

what: how many windows are on the plan
how: count the window symbols found by the detector
flag the count when detections sit near the confidence threshold

what: how many rooms / spaces are on the plan
how: count the enclosed outlines in the room database

what: how many toilets / WC bowls are on the plan
how: count the toilet symbols found by the detector

what: which doors (or windows) one named room has, and how wide they are
how: find the room by its name
list the openings whose wall gap touches it
give each measured width

what: which room is the largest / biggest
how: compare the areas of all rooms
return the one with the largest area

what: check the plan against regulations, codes, rules; would it pass an inspection
how: run every rule in regulations/rules.json on the room database
report passed, failed and not checked
attach the clause to each finding

what: what is drawn inside one named room: furniture, equipment, notes, layout
how: find the room by its name
cut the room from the drawing at full resolution
ask a vision model about the crop
label the answer as a model reading

what: anything else: cost, schedule, people, materials not drawn, questions about another topic
how: no stored pattern fits
the question goes to the planner model, which reads the recipes and the data dictionary
